name: bun
description: Fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager

tools.description: All-in-one JavaScript toolkit with native performance and Zig implementation
tools.usage:
bun install # Ultra-fast package installation with global cache
bun run --hot server.ts # Hot reload TypeScript development server
bun build --minify --splitting ./src/index.ts --outdir dist # Production build with code splitting
bun test --watch --coverage # Test runner with coverage and file watching
bun create react-app my-app # Scaffold new projects from templates
